title: v1.1.0
summary: Overview llama.cpp v1.1.0 adds the Inkling 2 family (base, Mini and DSpark), Domyn Edge 4B, Zaya1 8B, RAON-1-mini and Hy4 flash, splits DFlash speculative decoding into separate draft methods, and deprecates the old llama_batch API in favour of llama_batch_ext . It brings a large set of TTS and audio models (Kokoro, Zonos3-Mini, tiny-voca, VoxCPM2, MiniMax-Music3, YuE2, Fish S2, Higgs v3/VibeVoice-ASR and Kyutai Hibi
body:
llama.cpp v1.1.0 adds the Inkling 2 family (base, Mini and DSpark), Domyn Edge 4B, Zaya1 8B, RAON-1-mini and Hy4 flash, splits DFlash speculative decoding into separate draft methods, and deprecates the old llama_batch API in favour of llama_batch_ext . It brings a large set of TTS and audio models (Kokoro, Zonos3-Mini, tiny-voca, VoxCPM2, MiniMax-Music3, YuE2, Fish S2, Higgs v3/VibeVoice-ASR and Kyutai Hibiki), token-aware chat parsing, named tool choice, automatic per-tensor quantization targeting a bpw or size budget, a slot-scheduling refactor in llama-server , a redesigned Llama Chat web UI with voice messages and agent traces, and updates ggml to v1.1.1.

- llama.h: deprecate the old llama_batch API in favour of llama_batch_ext and llama_process ( #32306 , #32356 )

- llama.h: add llama_dflash_variant and llama_model_dflash_variant() for the four DFlash draft heads ( #32016 )

- llama.h: add llama_model_meta_arr_n() and llama_model_meta_arr_str() to read GGUF string arrays ( #32397 )

- llama.h: add target_bpw , target_size , state_file and abort callback to llama_model_quantize_params ( #15550 )

- mtmd.h: add audio types for Zonos3, YuE2, MiniMax-Music3, Fish S2, Moshi, Kokoro, tiny-voca, VoxCPM2 ( #32020 , #32330 , #32369 , #32413 , #32427 , #32435 , #32443 , #32491 )

- mtmd.h: add n_channels , mtmd_gen_audio_g2p() and mtmd_gen_state_get_ref_codes() ( #32413 , #32586 )

- server: accept OpenAI named tool_choice and add GET /models/sse in single-model mode ( #31564 , #32398 )

- server: add --ui-agent and --ui-mcp-proxy-allow-private-urls ( #33004 , #32633 )

- Inkling 2 (text + vision), Inkling 2 DSpark and Inkling 2 Mini ( #32217 , #32218 , #32694 )

- Domyn Edge 4B: interleaved SWA with RoPE only on SWA layers and Q/K norm ( #32559 )

- MiniMax-M3.1 ( #32301 )

- RAON-1-mini-preview: 30B-A4B MoE ( #32176 )

- Hy4 flash: 220B (12B active) text and vision on the DSA iSWA cache ( #32960 )

- DFlash2 for Recursive Ripple-65B-Preview ( #31904 )

- TTS: Kokoro, Zonos3-Mini and tiny-voca ( #32413 , #32020 , #32427 )

- Kyutai Hibiki / Moshi realtime full-duplex voice in/out ( #32491 )

- split DFlash speculative decoding into draft-dflash , draft-dflash2 , draft-dspark and draft-lilicorr ( #32016 )

- use GDN replay instead of rollback ( #31669 )

- add --target-bpw / --target-size per-tensor quant selection with a resumable state file ( #15550 )

- match special tokens in chat parsing instead of text (token-aware parsing) ( #29307 )

- speed up BPE tokenization and the PLaMo-2/3 tokenizer table build ( #32859 , #32249 )

- move the MoE cache out of llama-graph and reserve graph nodes for it ( #32157 , #32636 )

- move the graph node budget and indexer key rotation choice into the model classes ( #32648 , #32653 )

- apply .scale tensors automatically and load ffn_gate_up_exps scales ( #32669 , #32657 )

- fix sticky NaN in recurrent state, k-pool layout on sequence edits and QSA k-pool scoring ( #31913 , #32137 , #32519 )

- fall back to buffered I/O on EIO and allocate the staging buffer from the CPU buffer type ( #32545 , #31438 )

- avoid an O(n_cells) scan per sequence removal in the KV cells ( #32380 )

- honor metaspace_prepend_scheme for SPM and always for BPE, and load YaRN hparams in the model base ( #31986 , #33038 , #33032 )

- fix per-sequence state restore with ON_DEVICE KV caches ( #30318 )

- use the indexed bias FATTN path in Inkling 2 and map Inkling-2 LoRA tensor names ( #33053 , #33055 )

- add LLAMA_MOE_RANDOM_ROUTING=1 for benchmark-only random expert selection ( #29539 )

- optimize grammar matching with left factoring and fix an integer overflow ( #29557 , #32551 )

- allow up to llama_max_devices() configs for --tensor-split and --fit-target ( #31435 )

- jinja: scope-chain key lookup, sort_keys=true , 4 missing features and lower rendering overhead ( #32396 , #32366 , #32352 , #32023 )

- chat: inkling parser, undeclared LFM2 tool calls, tool calls in reasoning, lazy grammar ( #32381 , #32164 , #32271 , #32232 , #32497 )

- chat: implement named tool_choice and pass reasoning_effort=none when supported ( #31564 , #32763 )

- json-schema: accept boolean "value": true and reject out-of-range grammar triggers ( #32908 , #31478 )

### Multi-modality changes

- add support for VoxCPM2, MiniMax-Music3, YuE2-3B, Fish Audio S2 and Higgs Audio v3/VibeVoice-ASR ( #32443 , #32435 , #32369 , #32330 , #32329 )

- drama3 voice cloning and Qwen3-TTS ICL/reference mode ( #32586 , #32438 )

- speed up the shared audio FFT and avoid padding-only Whisper audio chunks ( #32815 , #30403 )

- allow a custom video decoder and fix video pixel aspect ratio and rotation ( #32188 , #32267 )

- merge Parakeet rel-pos views to avoid OOB, fix YuE2 projector loading and the qwen3a audio tail ( #32722 , #32606 , #32697 )

- add --tts-lang , --tts-voice and --tts-speaker-text for per-model TTS voices ( #32330 , #32586 )

- refactor slot scheduling into server_slot_sched with per-prompt running hashes ( #32154 )

- retry cached prompt restoration after clearing idle slots and preserve entries until restores succeed ( #30997 , #32828 , #28992 )

- clear slot cache when the global LoRA config changes ( #30367 )

- reuse HTTP connections after streamed responses ( #30492 )

- include MCP image and audio data in tool results ( #32064 )

- add offset pagination to grep_search and ask exec_shell_command for a short description ( #32792 , #32894 )

- return 400 for rejected reasoning_effort levels and grammar with ignore_eos , fix output_config.effort ( #32332 , #32377 , #32321 )

- ignore empty stop strings ( #32093 )

- fit non-causal batches in one ubatch and enable packing for d1-2B/d1-Omni-2B ( #32713 , #32553 )

- skip MCP discovery for router children ( #32359 )

- fix sleep state and transcription prompt for /v1/realtime ( #32567 , #32507 )

- handle CTRL_BREAK_EVENT on Windows for clean shutdown ( #32080 )

- fix LoRA and recurrent slot scheduling ( #32434 )

- move the web UI to ui/apps/chat as Llama Chat, with a Llama UI design system and Storybook ( #32032 , #32468 , #32485 )

- move to SvelteKit 3 and cut first-load JavaScript by 63% with on-demand diagrams, math and PDFs ( #32463 , #32555 )

- add voice messages and dictation with live waveforms and transcripts ( #32531 )

- show agentic replies as a grouped Agent Trace, with the loop in @ggml-org/llama-harness ( #32879 , #32927 )

- run Llama Chat apart from llama-server, via npx @ggml-org/llama-chat or a config URL ( #32524 , #32945 )

- make Llama Chat a plain chat unless the server offers agent features ( #32949 )

- add --ui-agent for agent mode without server tools or the MCP proxy ( #33004 )

- set the reasoning effort from the model picker and add a cancel button for model loading ( #32632 , #32225 )

- import conversations or settings by dropping them anywhere in the app ( #32958 )

- search message content and Discover models from the search dialog ( #32670 )

- open the context gauge as a popover and add a full-screen diagram preview ( #32685 , #32591 )

- hide Models and MCP behind settings, turn conversation tabs and the live markdown preview off by default ( #32527 , #32402 , #32469 )

- slim the design tokens and set all text through type roles ( #32615 )

- open Settings, the + menu and the model picker as sheets on phones, and manage MCP from Settings ( #33036 )

- stop the streaming reply with Escape and make npx llama-chat default to :9931 ( #33051 , #33095 )

- v1.1.0 : ggml v1.1.0 extends the graph API for new model families, strengthens scheduler and backend behavior, and brings broad performance work across all backends. The API gains gated-delta-net replay, flash-attention indexed bias, ordered asynchronous host input copies, and scheduler scratch reservation, plus new SLEEP and SIGMOID_BACK operators. Core adds BF16 coverage for more operations, faster quantization and math helpers, and new CPU quant kernels, while backends add stream-k matmul, chunked command buffers, NVFP4, CONV_2D acceleration, wider FP8/BF16 support, and many tuning and correctness fixes.

- v1.1.1 : ggml v1.1.1 lands Hexagon 2.0 with INT-HMX W8A8 matmul, automatic F32 to F16 lowering and generic DMA pipelines, and brings a CUDA FlashAttention data-loading refactor, a SYCL gated-delta-net ESIMD kernel with fused recurrent convolutions, small-K Metal mat-vec tuning, and a WebGPU log1p for softplus. It also adds the TANH backward pass, OpenVINO decode and op-test fixes, and 16-head lightning-indexer support on CUDA.

- Releases and versioning of ggml-org projects
